day_local: Isniinta Todobaadkii Soddomaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda iyo nimcada Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jiraan dhammaantiin.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: U dhaqma sida Ilaah carruurtiisa aadka u jecel.
homily:
Bal ka fikir subax ay qorraxdu soo baxdo, oo aad aragto geed ku taalla agagaarka il biyo socota leh, oo caleemihiisu ay cagaar yihiin, oo midhihiisa ay xilligooda soo saaraan. Geedkani ma laha cabsi ah in abaar timaado, waayo xididdadiisu waxay galaan halka ay biyuhu ka qulqulayaan. Waxaa jira xasilooni qoto dheer oo ku jirta aragtidaas — geed aan la gariirin dabaysha, maxaa yeelay wuxuu ku taagan yahay meel ay nafaqadu joogto. Waxaan maanta ka bilaabaynaa sawirkan fudud ee ka dhex muuqda nabadda dabiiciga ah, halkaas oo ay naftu ku nasanayso.

Laakiin nolosha dhabta ah, mararka qaarkood waxay u egtahay wax ka duwan. Waxaynu maanta maqalnay Injiilka oo ka sheekaynaya haweeney saddex iyo toban sano la xannuunsanayd xaalad adag, iyada oo la laabantay oo awood u la'ayd inay madaxa kor u taagto. Waxay ahayd xannuun culays ku hayay jirkeeda iyo nafteeda muddo dheer. Sidaas oo kale, qalbiyada bini'aadamka ayaa mararka qaarkood qaada culaysyo aynaan keligeen qaadi karin. Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo xambaarsan xanuun weyn oo aan erey lagu soo koobi karin. Waxaa jira daqiiqado marka gurigu aamuso, oo aad dareemaysaan in culaysku uu idin laabany ejecución yahay. Waxaan rabaa inaan halkan si daacad ah u joogsano. Ilaah wuu idin arkaa. Wuu arkaa ilmo kastoo idinka daadata, wuu arkaa dadaalkiinna, wuu arkaa jacaylka qoto dheer ee aad weli u haysaan Benjamin Vo. Xanuunkan culus ee idin haysta waa mid aan la inkiri karin, laakiin fadlan ogaada tan: ma jiro wax khalad ah oo aad samayseen. Xanuunka noocan ah ee soo wajaha qoysaska ma aha ciqaab, mana aha mid ka yimid wax aad ka gaabiseen. Sida Ciise u caddeeyay in xanuunka ninkii indhaha la' uusan ahayn dambiga waalidkiis ama kiisa, sidaas oo kalena waa runtiinna. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna wuxuu ahaa mid aan xad lahayn. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha halkaas oo aanu xanuun dambe jirin.

Oo halkaas ayuu Ciise ka soo galayaa bartamaha culayska. Injiilka dhexdiisa, wuxuu arkay haweeneydii foorarsanayd, wuxuuna ku yiri: 'Naagey, waxaad ka xorowday cudurkaaga.' Wuu taabtay, isla markiiba way istaagtay iyada oo toosan, waxayna ammaanayso Ilaah. Ciise ma uusan sugin maalin kale; wuxuu u yimid inuu jabiyo silsiladaha xannuunka. Wiilkeenna qaaliga ahaa, Benjamin, wuxuu ahaa wiil leh maskax aad u cajaa'ib badan. Wuxuu ahaa wiil jecel inuu barto waxyaabaha waaweyn ee tiknoolajiyadda, ka shaqeeya nidaamyada AWS, oo la wadaaga aabbihiis riyooyinka diyaaradaha iyo samaynta 'con chim airlines' — kaas oo uu markaan xasuusto uu si farxad leh u gigis iyo dhoola caddayn ugu sheegi jiray. Wuxuu ahaa wiil qalbigiisu uu ka buuxay naxariis saafi ah. Xusuusnow daqiiqaddii uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabayo inuu bixiyo piggy bank-giisa oo dhan si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanaa. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn in la jabiyo, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu diyaar u yahay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo waa calaamad muujinaysa ruuxa quruxda badan ee uu lahaa.

Ben wuxuu hadda joogaa meel ka sarreysa daruuraha, oo ah halkaas 'Banquet of Heaven'. Wuxuu idin leeyahay ha cabsanina. Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, xusuuso in Ben uu weli ku jiro wadnahaaga. Ha ka baqina inaad nolosha horay uga sii wadaan, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdaan, sidii wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa inuu arko.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-eedeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in Ilaah uu yahay kan kuu dhow, oo jacaylkiisu uusan weligiis dhammaanayn. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise Mowloyoow, waxaan rumeysanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sakramenta Quduuska ah ee Meesha Aabbaha. Waxaan kaa jeclahay wax kasta, waxaana jeclaan lahaa inaan naftayda kuugu deeqo. Maaddaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin Sakramenta, fadlan ku imow xaggee naftayda ruux ahaan. Waan ku soo dhoweynayaa sidii adigoo hore u joogay, waxaana ku biirinayaa naftayda adiga oo dhan. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbi ha idin barakeeyo oo ha idin dhowro. Nabadda Masiix ha idinla joogto maanta iyo weligeedba. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: U ducee wiilka Ben iyo dhammaan inta dhimatay, inay ku nastaan nuurka Masiix.
U ducee dhammaan kuwa la xannuunsanaya murugada, in Ilaah qalbi qaboojiyo oo siiyo rajada.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalaheyow: Isu naxariista, oo isu qalbi jilciya, idinkoo isu cafiya sida Ilaah Masiix dhexdiisa idiinku cafiyay. Haddaba ku dayda Ilaah, sidii carruurtiisa aadka u jecel, oo jacayl ku socda, sida Masiixuba noogu jecel yahay oo uu isu bixiyay aawadeen allabari iyo qurbaan caraf udgoon u ah Ilaah. Anshax xumo ama wasakh kasta ama hami xun yaan xataa laga dhex sheegin idinka dhexdiisa, sidii ku habboon dadka quduuska ah; cayna ama hadal doqonimo ah ama hadal xun yaan jirin, kuwaas oo aan habboonayn, laakiin waxaa ka wanaagsan mahadnaq. Xaqiiqo taas ogaada, inuusan jirin nin anshax xumo ah, ama wasakh ah, ama hunguri xun leh, kaas oo ah sanam caabude, oo dhaxal ku leh boqortooyada Masiixa iyo tan Ilaah. Yaan cidna idinku dayin inuu ereyo madhan idinku qaldo, waayo waxyaalahan awgood ayay cadhada Ilaah ugu timaaddaa kuwa aan addeecin. Sidaa darteed ha la jirin iyaga. Waayo mar ayaad mugdi ahayd, laakiin hadda waxaad tihiin nuurka Rabbiga ku jira. Sida carruurta nuurka u socda.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text:
R. U dhaqma sida Ilaah carruurtiisa aadka u jecel.
Saarnaalaysan ninkii aan ku socon talada kuwa sharka leh,
né jidka dembiilayaasha taagnaan,
né fadhiisan fadhiga kuwa caytamaya,
Laakiin ku raaxaysta sharciga RABBI,
oo sharcigiisa ka fekera habeen iyo maalin.
R. U dhaqma sida Ilaah carruurtiisa aadka u jecel.
Wuxuu la mid yahay geed
ku beeran biyaha qulqulaya agtooda,
Kaas oo midhihiisa soo saara xilligooda,
oo caleemihiisu aysan weligood engegin.
Wax kasta uu sameeyo wuu ku barwaaqoobaa.
R. U dhaqma sida Ilaah carruurtiisa aadka u jecel.
Sidaas ma aha kuwa sharka leh, sidaas ma aha;
Waxay la mid yihiin buush dabayshu kaxayso.
Waayo RABBI wuu ilaaliyaa jidka kuwa xaq ah,
Laakiin jidka kuwa sharka leh wuu baaba'aa.
R. U dhaqma sida Ilaah carruurtiisa aadka u jecel.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise ayaa sunagoga ku wax barayay maalinta sabtida. Oo halkaas waxaa joogtay naag soddon sano ay ruux ku haystay cudur, oo ay laabantahay, oo ay awood u la'ayd inaysan madaxa kor u qaadin habkaan. Markii Ciise arkay ayuu u yeeray oo ku yiri, "Naagey, waxaad ka xorowday cudurkaaga." Gacmihiisa ayuu saaray, oo isla markiiba way istaagtay toosan oo ammaanayso Ilaah. Laakiin hoggaamiyihii sunagoga, oo ka xanaaqay in Ciise uu sabtidii bogsiiyay, ayaa dadkii u jawaabay oo yiray, "Waxaa jira lix maalmood oo shaqada la qabto; marka soo taga si laydin bogsiiyo, ee ma aha maalinta sabtida." Rabbigu wuxuu ugu jawaabay oo ku yiri, "Munaafaqiinow! Mid kasta oo idinka mid ah miuusan sabtida furin dibigigiisa ama dameerkiisa oo uusan ka kaxayn marinarkii oo uusan u kaxayn biyaha la waraabiyo? Haweeneydan oo ah gabadhii Ibraahim, oo Shaytan xirnaa muddo soddon sano ah, miyaanay habboonayn in laga furo maalinta sabtida xariggaas?" Markuu waxaas yiri, dhammaan cadowgiisa way ceeboobeen; dadkiina oo dhan waxay ku farxeen falalka qurux badan ee uu sameeyay.

day: Monday of the Thirtieth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
